visualReview.scope: Detailed exterior reconstruction of the present Stone Bridge in Skopje.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable frames. Unequal river arches, sloping approaches, masonry joints, cutwaters, parapet courses, prayer niche and opposite projecting balcony are visible. Corrected cutwater normals now light consistently; the niche has a continuous backing, carved transition and attached header plaque.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current shared-material frames. Canonical travertine and fired-clay surfaces give the stone and approach brick a consistent fine grain without painting a second grid over modeled masonry joints. Close views resolve the arch blocks, course joints, rosettes and cornices. Model and shared material loading/unloading checks pass.

geographicReview.notes: Exact bridge footprint way 734159692/Q1780883 sets anchor [21.433244271,41.9971125], heading 0.7410149177885357 and 218.918m mapped length. Native +X points northeast and +Z southeast/downstream. Five mapped river-pier projections establish four unequal central bays; cutwater and niche placement agree with the captured map outline. Native Y=0 is channel-bottom elevation 241.5m from JICA 2009 Table2.1, survey section N5, not water level. The deck profile and exposed approach arches are reconstructed from published photographs; the source is not a current vertical survey or river-stage measurement.

fidelityReview.notes: 466,084-triangle exterior: individually jointed ashlar faces, radial voussoirs and brick approach vaults, unequal river bays, pyramidal and open cutwaters, sloped stone paving, two-course parapets, cornices, carved prayer niche and corbelled viewing balcony. Tourism and historical sources disagree on 13 versus 14–15 total openings; this reconstruction has 11 exposed/reconstructed bays and does not claim a surveyed inventory of buried arches. Ornament, exact arch profiles and shore-end closures are photographic reconstructions. Nearby statues, urban landscaping, buried masonry, inscriptions and interiors are outside this asset.
